title: Leab-Tui 3D — Traditional Xiangqi Trick-Taking Studio
description: A bilingual, interactive 3D studio for เลี๊ยบตุ่ย (Leab-Tui), the Thai trick-taking game played with the 32 tiles of a Chinese chess set. Vanilla HTML5, CSS3 and ES2022 JavaScript with Three.js r160 from a pinned CDN.

build.includes: Rules research and interpretation; pure rules engine; heuristic AI; four-seat game flow; undo snapshots; 3D table with 32 carved tiles and procedural textures; OrbitControls; responsive portrait camera; bilingual EN/TH copy; coach, inspector and hint; synthesised Web Audio; localStorage autosave; JSON export; self-test; CDP verification harness; screenshots; release documentation.

releaseHistory.summary: Initial release: rules engine, four-seat 3D table, AI, bilingual coach, inspector, undo, audio, persistence and documentation.
Display settings: four interface text sizes and three themes (Mahogany, Jade Court, Midnight Lacquer) with matching UI and 3D table palettes.

releaseNotes: 1.1.0 adds a Display panel with Small/Default/Large/Extra large text and Mahogany/Jade Court/Midnight Lacquer themes. Theme changes recolor the panels, felt, wood, inlay and lighting; text size scales the interface only.
